summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressFileContext, _make_file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads), tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests before the script-entry block), docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections), CHANGELOG.md (one Added entry). The diff is additive only (795 insertions, 0 deletions). Nothing was executed per the spec, so tests, mypy, and black are unverified. Known risks: on Python 3.6, typing.IO's abstract mode and name may block instantiating the reader; the module-level open opens the file at call time, so a reader that is never entered keeps its handle open until garbage collection.
